messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — need to lock calendar for vendor onramp and joint announcement windows for H200, H100, MI300, Gaudi. @Sara can you confirm vendor embargo dates from NVIDIA/AMD/Habana?
Sara Martinez: Working on it. I have an Nvidia contact who said H200 beta docs land early July, embargo TBC. I'll ping.
Mike O'Neill: For infra planning, we need 4 weeks lead time for Dedicated pools + marketplace images. That means any public announce needs to be 6w after vendor ship date.
Priya Patel: Noted. Also SI partners need a cert kit. Proposed internal timeline:

```
- Vendor GA (week 0)
- Redwood internal prep + cert kit (wk 0-2)
- SI partner trial (wk 2-4)
- Marketplace listing + public docs (wk 4-6)
- Joint announcement (wk 6)
```

Diane Yu: Is that 6 weeks from vendor GA or from Redwood availability? We should tie to Redwood's GA onramp.
Alex Chen: Good point — tie to Redwood availability. So profile it as: Redwood-ready by wk 4 after vendor GA, marketplace + joint announce at wk 6 after vendor GA.
Irving Gomez: For Gaudi and MI300 we also need to validate quantization paths. That can add 1 week for runtime kernel tuning. Marking as risk.
Sara Martinez: Nvidia said embargo through end of June for H200 roadmap details. AMD Mark (internal contact) expects MI300 wider availability late Q3. Habana rep said Gaudi parts are shipping but SI docs lag.
Mike O'Neill: Action items:
- @Sara: confirm explicit embargo windows with each vendor by EOD Thu
- @Irving: run kernel smoke for MI300/Gaudi by next Tue
- @Diane: draft marketplace listing template and compliance checklist by Fri
- @Priya: prepare cert kit stub (inventory + test plan) by next Wed

Priya Patel: I'll start the cert kit. Need sample image requirements from infra. @Mike can you drop the AMI/Docker image spec?
Mike O'Neill: Dropping spec here:
```
IMAGE_REQUIREMENTS= {
  "base": "ubuntu-22.04",
  "gpu_driver": "nvidia-554.XX / amd-driver-5.0",
  "cuda": "12.1",
  "python": "3.10",
}
```

Sara Martinez: Also, legal asked for an embargo checklist for joint press. Suggest this minimal set:
- mutual embargo dates
- approved quote list
- logos and trademark approvals
- channel owners for social cadence

Alex Chen: If vendors give us a soft GA (no public announce) can we do a partner-only marketplace early access? Thoughts?
Diane Yu: Yes — partner-only offer is doable via feature flags in console and gating via partner teams. Helps SI ramp without breaking embargo.
Irving Gomez: Risk: telemetry/keys for partner-only must be segregated — will need additional config, ~2 days dev.
Priya Patel: I'll add partner-only test scenarios to cert kit.
Mike O'Neill: Quick ask to the group: if we aim for a joint announcement around 2026-09-15 (tentative), vendor GA should be ~2026-08-04. Can vendors meet that?
Sara Martinez: I'll report back after vendor calls.
Alex Chen: Great — let's treat this thread as the runbook. I'll update with vendor replies. :thumbsup:
partnerships-bot: Reminder: weekly partnerships sync tomorrow 10:00 — add this as a standing agenda item for HW onramp.
Sara Martinez: added.
